design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) - Adapted for Industrial Premium

headings.style: uppercase, tracking-tighter, leading-none, font-bold to font-black
headings.description: Industrial, towering, authoritative. Used for massive kinetic text and manifesto numbers.

body.description: Clean, highly legible, geometric sans for technical precision in body copy.

accents.description: Used for overlines, coordinates, specs, and chapter labels.

colors.primary_description: Prochem Red - used for 'PROCHEM', high-impact highlights, and kinetic hover states.
colors.secondary_description: Tapasya Blue - used for 'TAPASYA', secondary structural elements, and trust markers.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crystal Glass for sticky nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px border-white/40). Flat solid for product cards with sharp edges.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using black/10 for grid structures. Visible grid lines in the capabilities section.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on sharp contrast and borders. Use soft drop-shadow only for floating elements like the nav.
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle SVG noise overlay fixed in the background at 2% opacity to remove digital flatness.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial Y offset 100%, animate to 0% inside an overflow-hidden wrapper).
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory for the premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images inside clipped frames scale up slightly (scale 1.05) on hover. Buttons feature a background color sweep.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle react-spring-parallax or Framer Motion useScroll for floating geometric shapes in the hero and chapter numbers moving at slower rates than content.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: react-fast-marquee running slowly across the screen with massive outline text for industries.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 for section padding. Negative space is a core design element.
layout_and_grids.products_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid. md:grid-cols-12, gap-8. Mix col-span-8 (Hero product), col-span-4 (Supporting). Not all squares filled perfectly.
layout_and_grids.capabilities: List-based accordion or massive hover-reveal table. Left column: numbered list, Right column: changing image based on hover.

sections_and_components.name: Sticky Nav
sections_and_components.instructions: Glassmorphism header (z-50). Logo: PROCHEM in text-primary, TAPASYA in text-secondary. Anchor links on right. Hide links on mobile behind a sleek hamburger.

sections_and_components.name: Kinetic Hero
sections_and_components.instructions: Massive H1 (text-6xl md:text-8xl). 'INTEGRATED PROCESS SOLUTIONS'. Masked reveal. Background features a subtle 3D rotating metallic particle (React Three Fiber) OR abstract floating geometry if 3D isn't viable. Call to action button with arrow icon.

sections_and_components.name: Stats Band
sections_and_components.instructions: Grid-cols-3 layout. Features large numbers (text-5xl): '60+ Years', '50+ Countries', '#1 Market Leader in Saizoner'. Use Mono font for labels.

sections_and_components.name: Manifesto / About
sections_and_components.instructions: Numbered chapters ('01. OUR VISION', '02. OUR VALUES'). Swiss editorial layout. Large numbers positioned absolutely behind the text (text-[10rem] text-black/5).

sections_and_components.name: Process Capabilities
sections_and_components.instructions: Interactive list. Huge typography. Hovering over a capability (e.g., 'Granulation') reveals a corresponding industrial image in a fixed position or alongside.

sections_and_components.name: Products Grid
sections_and_components.instructions: Showcase 12 machine products using the bento grid. Product photography inside clipped frames (sharp edges). Gray/stainless machinery on stark white or light gray cards. Spotlight effect on hover.

sections_and_components.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_and_components.instructions: Massive text outline marquee (text-8xl text-transparent border-text stroke-black). Words: PHARMACEUTICAL • NUTRACEUTICAL • FOOD • CHEMICAL • COSMETICS.

sections_and_components.name: Global Operations
sections_and_components.instructions: Minimal map or coordinate list. Dark section to contrast with the rest of the page (bg-black text-white), showing global reach.

sections_and_components.name: Footer / Contact
sections_and_components.instructions: Massive CTA ('START A PROJECT'). Strict grid layout for contact details. High contrast.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure red/blue text against white meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.motion: Implement prefers-reduced-motion checks for the Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion reveals.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (nav links, product cards, CTA) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-about', data-testid='cta-hero').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts in index.html or import in CSS: Oswald (weights 400,600,700), Manrope (weights 400,500,600), IBM Plex Mono (weights 400,500).
Build this entirely in Javascript (.jsx/.js files, NO TypeScript).
This is a single-page scrolling site. Implement sticky navbar with IDs for smooth scrolling.
Design with severe, sharp industrial aesthetics. Use padding aggressively (p-12 to p-32).
The Hero text MUST use a masked line-by-line reveal animation via Framer Motion.
Product images must have a spotlight hover effect or simple scale-up within an overflow-hidden frame.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use grid lines and asymmetrical bento grids.
Do NOT add a generic transition: all to everything. Only target specific properties.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
